scientific_integrity: The all-parameter formulas and equality classification follow from an analytic strict-convexity/vertex/one-positive-blade proof. The finite exact-integer verifier checks instances but is not an infinite certificate. Prior-art comparison is nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Uniform counting probability, real one-Lipschitz functions, at least two unweighted cliques meeting at exactly one common hub; no assertion for weighted vertices, general block graphs, other moments or subgaussian optimal constants. This is not an independent validation.
title: Partition discrepancy and a dominant-blade phase transition for graph spread of clique bouquets
